name: Claude Code Tee More Tokens AI Coding Humor Unisex Cotton Shirt
description:
If you live in the terminal and your heart rate spikes every time you see a context window filling up, this tee was made for you. The More Token graphic tee is a love letter to everyone riding the Claude Code wave — developers, AI engineers, prompt obsessives, and anyone who has ever watched their token limit tick toward zero mid-thought. Funny, relatable, and unapologetically nerdy, this shirt says everything your context window sometimes cannot.

Worn by the builders of tomorrow, this unisex tee sits at the intersection of software culture and everyday style. Whether you are shipping at 2am, presenting at a hackathon, or just grabbing coffee before your next deployment, it holds up in every environment — much like Claude Code itself.

---

**THE SHIRT**

Crafted from 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, this lightweight 4.2 oz/yd² tee delivers genuine breathable comfort you can feel the moment you put it on. The retail fit features a classic crew neckline with side seams that give it a clean, modern silhouette — not boxy, not oversized, just right. Reinforced shoulder tape keeps its shape wash after wash, and the ribbed knit collar stays looking fresh long after your thousandth token request.

The design is applied using high-quality DTF/DTG printing, so the graphic stays vibrant, crisp, and peel-resistant over time. A tear-away label means zero scratchy distractions at the back of your neck while you are deep in a session.

This is a true unisex fit. Sizing runs true to size across S, M, L, XL, 2XL, and 3XL — order your usual size with confidence.

---

**CARE INSTRUCTIONS**

Machine wash cold — max 30°C / 90°F
Non-chlorine bleach only if needed
Tumble dry on low heat
Iron or steam on medium heat
Do not dry clean

Turning the garment inside out before washing will help preserve the print for longer.

---

**PERFECT FOR**

Anyone who bleeds semicolons, dreams in API calls, and genuinely believes that more tokens is never a bad thing. Gift it, wear it, or keep it for yourself — it earns its place in every developer wardrobe.
